sources.title: SN108 · Prometheon — Mining Playbook — OpenTAO
sources.snippet: Mining playbook for subnet 108 (Prometheon). Photorealistic talking-head video generation. Miners take a reference image + text (+ optional voice profile), render a lip-synced clip behind an HTTP API, upload to Cloudflare R2, and return the URL. Validators score realism + identity + motion, with a latency bonus on top.
